title: MC Remastered Deluxe Edition
description: Attempts to enhance Minecraft to make it almost feel like a sequel. Aims to make everything feel new and modern.
body:
Mc Remastered Deluxe Edition is a modpack that aims to enhance minecraft's visuals and gameplay. It attempts to make the game almost feel like a sequel, trying to make everything feel new and modern. Adds new mobs and new places and biomes in dimensions and enhances every dimension from the overworld to the end.

Bliss shaders from: https://github.com/X0nk/Bliss-Shader
